meaning:
πενιχρός, -ά, -όν
(πένομαι, see: πένης) [in LXX: Exo.22:25 (עָנִי), Pro.28:15 29:7 (דַּל) * ;]

elsewhere.note: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.
